tpv-account-missing: There is no active bank account with subaccount %account%...
tpv-action-needs-confirmation: This action changes existing data and needs confirmation.
tpv-action-setup-all-desc: Enables the API and creates the missing tables, accounts, subaccounts, payment methods, series, customer, API key and role. It does not change anything that already exists.
tpv-api-access-extra: Access to %resource%, which the POS does not use.
tpv-api-key-created: API key "%name%" created with the minimum permissions.
tpv-api-key-full-access: It has full access: it should be restricted to the POS resources.
tpv-api-key-production: Production permissions applied to the POS key.
tpv-api-key-regenerated: Key regenerated: change it in the POS settings.
tpv-api-key-test-profile: Test permissions applied to the POS key.
tpv-api-permissions-help: The POS key does not have full access: only the resources and methods the app uses. A request to any other resource is rejected and counts as an incident (five within ten minutes get the IP blocked).
tpv-app-db-host-local: From the tablet use this server's local network IP, not localhost.
tpv-app-db-password: The one shown when the user was generated.
tpv-app-db-tls-help: Always enable it in the app: with MySQL 8 (caching_sha2_password) it only authenticates reliably over TLS, and it is required if you ticked "Require encrypted connection".
tpv-app-url-local: This address points to this same computer (localhost): it does not work from the tablet. Use this server's local network IP (e.g. http://192.168.1.x/facturascripts) and, if you wish, save it as the site URL in the control panel.
tpv-cant-delete-ingredient: %ref% cannot be deleted: it is an ingredient of these recipes: %dishes%. Remove it from the recipes first.
tpv-check-accounts-missing: The cash or bank account, or its subaccount in the current exercise, is missing.
tpv-check-accounts-ok: There is a cash account and a bank account with their subaccount in the current exercise.
tpv-check-api-constant: The API works thanks to the api_key constant in config.php, but the "Enable API" setting is off: without the constant the POS key would stop working.
tpv-check-api-disabled: The REST API is disabled: the app cannot connect.
tpv-check-api-key-differs: The key exists but its permissions are not the ones the POS needs.
tpv-check-api-key-disabled: The key is disabled: the POS cannot use the API. If it was disabled for security reasons (a lost tablet), regenerate it instead of enabling it.
tpv-check-api-key-ok: The key exists, is enabled, has no full access and can only use the %count% resources the app needs.
tpv-check-api-key-test-profile: The key has the extended permissions for the integration tests (delete invoices, orders and entry lines, create and delete payment methods). Go back to the production ones when you are done.
tpv-check-costs-differs: %without% ingredients without cost and %differs% dishes whose product cost differs from the theoretical cost.
tpv-check-costs-ok: All recipe ingredients have a cost and the dish costs match the theoretical cost.
tpv-check-customer-differs: Customer %code% exists but would block POS sales.
tpv-check-customer-ok: Customer %code% exists, is active and has no maximum risk.
tpv-check-dishes: Dishes with recipe that do not control stock
tpv-check-dishes-none: There are no products with a recipe that are sold yet.
tpv-check-dishes-ok: The %count% products with a recipe that are sold have "Do not control stock".
tpv-check-dishes-with-stock: %count% products with a recipe that are sold control stock: FacturaScripts would deduct the dish as well as its ingredients and could block the sale.
tpv-check-duplicated-keys-found: There are documents with the same POS key: the app stops when it finds them ("Duplicated key"). Keep one per key.
tpv-check-duplicated-keys-ok: There are no POS tickets, orders or entries with the same key.
tpv-check-exercise-missing: There is no open exercise for %date%. Create it in Accounting > Exercises and import the accounting plan.
tpv-check-exercise-no-plan: Exercise %exercise% has no accounting plan: import it in Accounting > Exercises.
tpv-check-exercise-ok: Exercise %exercise% is open and has an accounting plan.
tpv-check-ingredients-none: There are no ingredients in the recipes yet.
tpv-check-ingredients-ok: The %count% ingredients of the recipes control stock.
tpv-check-ingredients-without-stock: %count% ingredients have "Do not control stock": the POS does not deduct them (it only records them in its journal) because FacturaScripts keeps no stock for them.
tpv-check-menu-ok: Everything sold has a recipe or stock tracking, and every family has a print destination.
tpv-check-menu-review: Review the menu: there are products that deduct nothing or families without a print destination.
tpv-check-mixed-products: Products that are both dish and ingredient
tpv-check-mixed-products-found: %count% products have a variant with a recipe and another that is an ingredient: "Do not control stock" belongs to the product and cannot suit both. Split the variants into different products.
tpv-check-mixed-products-ok: No product mixes dish and ingredient variants.
tpv-check-payment-differs: %code% exists but is not as the POS expects. It is not changed without your confirmation.
tpv-check-payment-ok: %code% exists, is active, marks invoices as paid, is due immediately and collects into the right account.
tpv-check-recipes-invalid: There are circular or too deep recipes: the POS deducts NO stock for any sale until they are fixed.
tpv-check-recipes-non-canonical: %count% recipe references are not written exactly as in the products: the POS, which is case-sensitive, does not recognise them.
tpv-check-recipes-ok: %count% dishes with a recipe; no cycles, no chains of more than 20 dishes with a recipe and references written as in the products.
tpv-check-refund-keys: Some refunds have the key of their ticket: fix them so the app does not stop if it has to resume that ticket.
tpv-check-requires-exercise: An open exercise with an accounting plan is needed first.
tpv-check-requires-tables: The POS tables must be created first.
tpv-check-restock-differs: The POS automatic restocking will not be able to order some ingredients, or there are orders not received.
tpv-check-restock-negative: There are negative minimum or maximum stocks: the app discards the whole restocking audit.
tpv-check-restock-ok: Ingredients have a minimum stock and restock orders are being received.
tpv-check-role-missing: The %role% role is missing plugin pages (this happens when the plugin is updated by copying its files).
tpv-check-role-ok: The %role% role can access all the plugin pages. To open products, invoices, supplier orders and accounting entries from them, assign it together with another role that includes them.
tpv-check-sale-without-stock-found: %count% products that are sold control stock and do not have "Allow sale without stock": if their stock runs short, FacturaScripts rejects the ticket invoice and the POS invoice queue stops.
tpv-check-sale-without-stock-ok: All products that control stock and are sold have "Allow sale without stock".
tpv-check-serie-not-simplified: Series %code% exists but is not simplified.
tpv-check-stock-stations-ok: No reference with stock belongs to both the kitchen and the bar.
tpv-check-stock-stations-review: Some references appear in both tabs of Hospitality › Stock: decide which station each one belongs to.
tpv-check-subaccounts-missing: Subaccounts are missing in exercise %exercise%: the POS will not be able to post the Z closure.
tpv-check-subaccounts-ok: There are subaccounts for 570, 572, 700, 477, 659 and 759 in exercise %exercise%.
tpv-check-tables-missing: POS tables or columns are missing.
tpv-check-tables-no-foreign-keys: Foreign keys are disabled in config.php (db_foreign_keys): deleting or renaming products will not update the recipes.
tpv-check-tables-ok: tpv_escandallos, tpv_movimientos_stock and the familias.tpv_destino column exist.
tpv-check-tables-unique-missing: Unique indexes of the POS tables are missing: the POS would duplicate recipe lines or stock movements.
tpv-check-warehouse-missing: There is no valid default warehouse: choose it in Admin > Control Panel > Default.
tpv-confirm-adjust-payments: The existing TPVEFE / TPVTAR payment methods will be changed: active, paid, due immediately and with the cash (570) or bank (572) account. Continue?
tpv-confirm-api-key-test-profile: Permissions to DELETE invoices, orders and entry lines, create and delete payment methods and read invoice lines and stock will be added to the key. Use it only for integration tests, never on the real installation. Continue?
tpv-confirm-copy-cost: The theoretical cost will be stored in the variants of this product that have a complete recipe. It only affects new sales. Continue?
tpv-confirm-copy-costs: The theoretical cost will be stored in the dishes with a complete recipe (variants with a margin are left alone). It only affects new sales. Continue?
tpv-confirm-enable-api-key: The current key will be enabled again. If it was disabled because a tablet was lost or stolen, it is better to regenerate it. Continue?
tpv-confirm-fix-api-key: The POS key will be left with exactly the production permissions and its full access will be removed if it had it (it is neither enabled nor disabled). Continue?
tpv-confirm-fix-customer: The maximum risk of customer TPV will be removed and it will be reactivated. Continue?
tpv-confirm-fix-dishes: These products will be marked "Do not control stock". FacturaScripts will delete their current stock. Continue?
tpv-confirm-fix-ingredients: "Do not control stock" will be removed from these ingredients. Continue?
tpv-confirm-fix-recipe-refs: Recipe references will be rewritten exactly as they are in the products. Continue?
tpv-confirm-fix-refund-keys: An "R" will be prepended to the "Number 2" of those refunds ("TPV-…" becomes "RTPV-…"). Only that free field changes: amounts, numbering and entries are not touched. Continue?
tpv-confirm-fix-sale-without-stock: "Allow sale without stock" will be enabled for these products. Continue?
tpv-confirm-fix-serie: Series S will be changed to type "simplified". Continue?
tpv-confirm-load-menu: The sample families, products, ingredients, suppliers, stock and recipes that do not exist will be created. Continue?
tpv-confirm-mysql-execute: The MySQL account %account% will be created with the password shown and the listed privileges. If the account already exists nothing will be changed. Continue?
tpv-confirm-mysql-reset: WARNING: if the account %account% already exists and is a POS account, its PASSWORD WILL BE CHANGED to the one shown, its TLS requirement will change and its privileges on these tables will become the minimum ones. The POS devices using it will stop connecting until you set the new password. Continue?
tpv-confirm-regenerate-api-key: A new key will be generated and the current one will stop working: it must be changed on every POS. Continue?
tpv-copy-cost: Copy the theoretical cost to the product
tpv-copy-cost-help: FacturaScripts uses the product cost for the profit of every sale (and in Reports). Only complete costs are copied; variants with a margin are left alone (FS would recalculate their price).
tpv-copy-cost-incomplete: %ref%: the cost is not copied, the recipe has ingredients without cost or is not valid.
tpv-copy-cost-margin: %ref%: the cost is not copied because the variant has a %margin% % margin and FacturaScripts would recalculate its sale price.
tpv-cost-help: Theoretical cost = Σ gross quantity × ingredient cost, with the same rule as the POS: a semi-finished product (an ingredient with its own recipe) is always costed through its recipe, down to the raw ingredients, ignoring its own cost. Gross quantity = net / (1 − waste / 100). Margin on the price before tax. * = incomplete cost.
tpv-customer-notes: Generic customer for POS receipts (simplified invoices).
tpv-customer-risk: It has a maximum risk (%risk%): FacturaScripts would reject invoices above it.
tpv-deduction-desc: What the POS deducts per unit sold: the gross quantity with 3 decimals (the stock precision).
tpv-default-no-sale-without-stock: In the Control Panel, "Allow out-of-stock sale on new products" is disabled: new products will not allow it.
tpv-destination-desc: Where orders for the products of this family are printed. Inherit = use the parent family destination.
tpv-destination-effective-desc: A routing rule configured in the POS takes precedence.
tpv-dish-cost-differs-margin: %ref%: theoretical cost %cost%, product cost %current%. It is not copied because the variant has a %margin% % margin (FacturaScripts would recalculate its sale price).
tpv-dish-desc: Reference (variant) of the dish, drink or semi-finished product this recipe belongs to.
tpv-ingredient-desc: Reference of the ingredient or semi-finished product. A semi-finished product (with its own recipe) is deducted through its ingredients.
tpv-ingredients-without-cost: Ingredients without cost (the theoretical cost is lower than the real one): %refs%
tpv-invalid-destination: Invalid POS destination: "%value%". Allowed values: cocina, barra or empty (inherit).
tpv-journal-rename-error: Could not rename %old% to %new% in the POS stock journal: cancellations of earlier orders will not find the reference.
tpv-menu-families-without-destination: %count% families with products for sale have no print destination: they will go to the POS default destination: %codes%
tpv-menu-load-error: The menu was not loaded: nothing has been saved.
tpv-menu-sample-data: Sample data created by the POS setup assistant (Hosteleria plugin).
tpv-menu-save-error: Error saving "%item%" of the sample menu.
tpv-menu-tax-missing: There is no active %tax% % tax: create it in Accounting > Taxes.
tpv-menu-without-recipe: %count% products are sold with "Do not control stock" and no recipe: neither FacturaScripts nor the POS deducts anything when they are sold (it may be intended): %refs%
tpv-mysql-cannot-verify-account: The privileges of the account %account% could not be read (SHOW GRANTS): it is not reset. Do it as root with the statements shown.
tpv-mysql-execute-error: Error in statement %num% of %total% (%count% were executed before): %error%
tpv-mysql-execute-error-undone: Error in statement %num% of %total% (%count% were run before): %error%. The account just created has been deleted so as not to leave it half done.
tpv-mysql-execute-help: "Run now" uses the FacturaScripts MySQL user, which needs the CREATE USER and GRANT OPTION privileges. If it lacks them, copy the statements and run them as root. An existing account is not changed unless you tick "Reset the password if the account already exists", and only if it is a POS account (with no privileges other than those on these tables).
tpv-mysql-executed-failed: The MySQL user could not be created.
tpv-mysql-executed-reset: Account %account% reset (new password and minimum privileges). Statements executed: %count%.
tpv-mysql-host-help: Pattern of the addresses the POS will connect from, e.g. 192.168.1.% for the whole local network or the exact IP of the tablet.
tpv-mysql-intro: The POS deducts stock and reads and saves recipes directly in MySQL. Create a user for it with the minimum privileges: on stocks, SELECT, INSERT and UPDATE of cantidad and disponible only; on variantes and productos, SELECT and UPDATE of stockfis (and actualizado) only; read access to productosprov and proveedores; on tpv_escandallos, SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE; on the tpv_movimientos_stock journal, SELECT and INSERT only (it cannot delete or change it). The tpv_* tables are created by the plugin. Never use the FacturaScripts account or root.
tpv-mysql-invalid-database: The database name in config.php is not valid.
tpv-mysql-invalid-host: Invalid host pattern: letters, digits, dots, hyphens, colons and %.
tpv-mysql-invalid-password: Invalid password: generate the statements again.
tpv-mysql-invalid-user: Invalid MySQL user: letters, digits and underscore, up to 32 characters.
tpv-mysql-no-mysqli: The PHP mysqli extension is not available.
tpv-mysql-not-tpv-account: The account %account% has privileges other than the POS ones (global, on the whole database or on other tables): it is not reset. Choose another user for the POS.
tpv-mysql-password-copy-now: Account ready. Copy the password now: it is not stored anywhere and will not be shown again.
tpv-mysql-password-once: Copy the password now: it is not stored anywhere and will not be shown again. If you lose it, generate another one.
tpv-mysql-reserved-user: That user cannot be used for the POS: it is the FacturaScripts MySQL account (config.php) or a system account (root, mysql.*...). Choose another one, e.g. tpv_comandero.
tpv-mysql-reset-password: Reset the password if the account already exists
tpv-mysql-statements: SQL statements (copy them and run them as MySQL administrator, or press "Run now")
tpv-mysql-tables-missing: The POS tables could not be created: privileges on them cannot be granted until they exist.
tpv-mysql-tls-help: Recommended: with MySQL 8 (caching_sha2_password authentication) the app needs TLS anyway.
tpv-mysql-user-exists: The account %account% already exists in MySQL and has not been changed. To change its password, tick "Reset the password if the account already exists": the POS devices using it will stop connecting until you give them the new one.
tpv-mysql-user-missing: The account %account% does not exist: there is no password to reset. Untick "Reset the password if the account already exists" to create it.
tpv-net-quantity-desc: Per unit of dish, in the unit the ingredient stock is kept in (kg, l or unit): 300 g of tomato = 0.3.
tpv-no-cost-price-policy: There is no cost price policy (Control Panel > Default): the ingredient cost is not updated with purchases.
tpv-not-deducted-nostock: "Do not control stock": the POS records it but does not deduct it
tpv-orphan-recipe-lines: %count% recipe lines with a dish or ingredient that no longer exists.
tpv-payment-not-paid: Invoices are not marked as paid (paid = no).
tpv-payment-wrong-account: Its bank account (%current%) has no %account%... subaccount.
tpv-recipe-below-stock-precision: When one unit of "%dish%" is sold, the POS will deduct nothing of "%ingredient%": it needs %gross%, less than the stock precision (0.001). Use a smaller unit for that ingredient (g, ml, unit).
tpv-recipe-cache-help: The POS reloads the recipes every 10 minutes (immediately if they are saved from the app itself): sales of a new dish within that interval do not deduct ingredients.
tpv-recipe-cycle: Circular recipe: "%ingredient%" already contains "%dish%" in its own recipe (%path%). The POS would stop deducting stock for every sale.
tpv-recipe-duplicate-ingredient: Ingredient "%ingredient%" is already in the recipe of "%dish%": edit its line.
tpv-recipe-empty: This product has no recipe yet.
tpv-recipe-graph-too-deep: More than %max% chained dishes with a recipe: %path%
tpv-recipe-invalid: Recipe not valid for the POS (cycle or too many levels)
tpv-recipe-invalid-help: The recipe is circular or chains too many levels of sub-recipes: the POS deducts no stock for any sale until it is fixed (see POS setup).
tpv-recipe-invalid-quantity: The quantity of "%ingredient%" in "%dish%" must be greater than 0 (received "%value%").
tpv-recipe-invalid-waste: The waste of "%ingredient%" in "%dish%" must be at least 0 and less than 100 (received "%value%").
tpv-recipe-self-ingredient: A dish cannot be an ingredient of itself ("%ref%").
tpv-recipe-stock-rounding: When one unit of "%dish%" is sold, the POS will deduct %tpv% of "%ingredient%" instead of %gross%: stock is kept with 3 decimals (%pct% % difference).
tpv-recipe-too-deep: The recipe of "%dish%" with "%ingredient%" chains %levels% dishes with a recipe (maximum %max%): the POS would stop deducting stock for every sale.
tpv-reference-deleted: The reference no longer exists in the products
tpv-reference-not-found: Reference "%ref%" does not exist in product variants.
tpv-referencia-not-unique: variantes.referencia has no unique index (foreign keys disabled): tpv_escandallos is created without foreign keys.
tpv-refunds-with-ticket-key: Refunds with the same key in "Number 2" as the ticket they refund ("TPV-…"): %count%. If the app had to resume one of those tickets, it would find two invoices and stop.
tpv-restock-open-orders: %count% POS restock orders have not been received for more than %days% days and hold back new restocking: %codes%
tpv-restock-without-minimum: %count% ingredients without minimum stock in the warehouse (they will never be ordered): %refs%
tpv-restock-without-supplier: %count% references with minimum stock and no active supplier (the POS only warns): %refs%
tpv-role-save-error: The Hosteleria role or its permissions could not be created.
tpv-sample-menu-intro: A restaurant from La Mancha: %families% families (Drinks to the bar and Kitchen to the kitchen, inherited by their subfamilies), %products% menu products, %ingredients% ingredients with stock, %suppliers% suppliers with their prices and %recipes% recipes. It does not change anything that already exists: existing families, suppliers and references are left as they are. Sugary soft drinks are sold at 10% VAT but bought at 21%: they are created without a supplier and must be ordered by hand with 21% VAT.
tpv-setup-admin-only: Only an administrator can set up the POS.
tpv-setup-intro: Checks that FacturaScripts has everything the POS app expects and fixes what is missing. Every action can be repeated without duplicating anything; actions that change existing data ask for confirmation.
tpv-stock-cross: They belong to one station because of their family, but dishes of the other station use them: %refs%. If that is not intended, use that station's own product in those dishes.
tpv-stock-journal-read-only: The POS stock journal is read-only: the POS writes it.
tpv-stock-no-erp-destination: Used by dishes whose family has no destination in the ERP, which count for neither tab (the POS prepares them at its default station or by its own rules): %refs%. Set a destination on those families (see "Menu and print destinations").
tpv-stock-shared: They appear in both tabs because kitchen and bar dishes use them and their family has no destination: %refs%. Move them to a family with a destination or create a product for each station.
tpv-stock-stations-help: Each reference belongs to the kitchen or the bar because of its family's POS destination (own or inherited); if its family has no destination, because of the dishes on sale that use it, at any recipe level. If both use it, it appears in both tabs with the same stock, because FacturaScripts keeps a single stock per warehouse (POS setup points them out). References without a destination only appear in Warehouse › Products › Stock.
tpv-stock-unassigned: Without a destination, they appear in neither tab (only in Warehouse › Products › Stock): %refs%.
tpv-subaccount-create-error: Subaccount %code% could not be created: check the accounting plan.
tpv-subaccount-missing: the subaccount does not exist in exercise %exercise%
tpv-subrecipe-incomplete-cost: Semi-finished product with ingredients without cost
tpv-summary-intro: Enter these values in the POS settings (server).
tpv-waste-desc: Percentage lost when cleaning or cooking (0 to 99.99).
tpv-z-closures-help: With the "mismatch only" mode (the app default) only the cash shortage or overage is posted: days when the cash count matches have no entry, and the amount of each entry is the mismatch. Daily sales are in the "Daily sales" tab.
